lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin attachment, with inter-blob spacing showing a semi-regular grid distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature characterized by a sharp luminance gradient—bright on the superior edge and shadowed on the inferior edge—running parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis across the upper third of the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped indentation or notch is visible on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated pisciform silhouettes with high-luminance trailing edges located near the ventral-pectoral junction.
